info.bio:
Collective Soul es una banda de rock alternativo/post-grunge proveniente de Georgia, EE.UU. y una de las bandas más importantes surgidas en los años 90, tras la muerte de Kurt Cobain, junto con otras como Weezer, Green Day o Foo Fighters.

Su estilo está enmarcado dentro del rock alternativo, y también experimentan sonidos grunge y hard-rock mezclados con pop y folk; lo que le da el caracter a la banda. Sus principales influencias incluyen a Elvis Presley

scenes.name: Grunge
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: El grunge, revival del hard rock de los setenta y renacimiento musical de Seattle, fue uno de los grandes fenómenos de los noventa (casi solo en EE UU). Green River lo inauguran (Come On Down) y Pearl Jam, Soundgarden, Melvins y Mudhoney fijan sus cuatro puntos cardinales; Nirvana, con Nevermind, lo convierten en una tragaperras y en la banda sonora de la crisis nerviosa de una generación. Después, Alice In Chains (Dirt), Foo Fighters, Hammerbox, GodHeadSilo, Everclear, Stone Temple Pilots, Tool (el grupo más innovador de la segunda generación: Aenima, Lateralus), God Machine, Helmet, Quicksand, Urge Overkill, los Smashing Pumpkins (Siamese Dream, Mellon Collie), Scarce, Creed, Bush, Manic Street Preachers, Silverchair.

podcast.title: Featured on Big Shiny Toons 2
podcast.body: Collective Soul was included in the 100% alt-rock track listing of Much Music's *Big Shiny Toons 2* compilation CD, released in 1997. This album achieved considerable success in Canada, selling over 1.2 million units. "featuring the prodigy, blur, Marilyn Manson, Bush, Collective Soul, the Tea Party, Radiohead, Stone Temple Pilots, and more."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Rise and Fall and Future of the Music Video - Part 2

podcast.title: First-Person Lyrical Approach
podcast.body: Collective Soul was cited as an example of a Post-Grunge band whose lyrical writing style prominently featured a "first person approach," contrasting with the more metaphorical lyrics often found in original Grunge bands. "Now think about the lyrical writing style of collective soul or bush or third eye blind and matchbox 20. You see what I mean?"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Twilight Soundtracks Contribution
podcast.body: Collective Soul contributed to the various *Twilight* soundtracks that accompanied the film series. These soundtracks featured a nice selection of tunes, mostly album cuts and outtakes, from a range of artists spanning different genres. "The Paramore, Lincoln Park, Collective Soul, Death Cab for Cutie, Tom York, the Killers, Editors, Metric, Block Keys, Dead Weather, Beck, Vampire Weekend, Florence in the Machine."
